model_annotation: The figure shows a set of small, repeated grouped bar charts intended to display one quantitative measure for multiple clinical specialties (as indicated by the legend) across several side-by-side category groups on the horizontal direction. The legend at the top maps six series to colors: Cardio (light blue), Gastro (very light peach), Infect (light orange), Neuro (orange), Obstetrics (medium brown), and Pediatrics (dark brown). The chart area does not show explicit axis titles, numeric tick labels, units, or gridlines; visually, bars originate from a common top baseline and extend downward, indicating values plotted below that baseline (a negative-direction vertical scale is implied, but the numeric range and interval are not shown). Along the horizontal axis there are six grouped positions (their group labels are not legible in the provided image), and within each group there are six adjacent vertical bars corresponding to the six specialties, arranged consistently in the same left-to-right color order. In the first (leftmost) group, all six bars are long downward bars, with the light-blue Cardio bar extending the farthest and the darker brown Pediatrics bar also among the longer bars, while the peach/orange series fall in between. In the second group, the Cardio bar is a prominent downward bar and the other five series form a cluster of shorter downward bars, with the dark-brown Pediatrics bar extending somewhat farther downward than the lighter orange bars. In the third group, Cardio again extends noticeably downward, while the remaining five bars are comparatively short downward bars (the dark-brown Pediatrics bar appears the deepest among those five). In the fourth group, Cardio is a deep downward bar and the other series are medium-to-long downward bars with increasing depth toward the darker brown shades, ending with the dark-brown Pediatrics bar as one of the deepest. In the fifth group, Cardio is a clear downward bar and the other five bars are shorter-to-medium downward bars, again ending with a darker brown Pediatrics bar that extends farther than most of the lighter orange bars. In the sixth (rightmost) group, Cardio extends downward prominently and the remaining five bars are medium downward bars with the dark-brown Pediatrics bar extending the farthest within that cluster. No bars appear stacked, no data labels or error bars are shown, and there is no visible sorting cue beyond the consistent series order within each grouped position.
